events.title: Creative Castle First Friday Art Walk
events.venue: Castle Street between Third and 12th streets, Wilmington, NC 28401
events.description: Free public art walk featuring local artists, music, shopping, dining and special activities at participating Castle Street businesses. Organizers: Home Plate Provisions and River’s Edge Art Supplies.
events.editor_note: Same-day event; the Arts Council confirms 5–9 p.m. and free public access.

events.title: Holiday Sip, Shop & Support
events.venue: Compass Pointe Country Club, 2405 The Pointe Club Drive, Leland, NC 28451
events.description: A holiday shopping and social event featuring local makers, festive refreshments and community giving. Host: Business By The Beach – Women’s Networking Group. Eventbrite registration/tickets required.
events.source_name: Business By The Beach – Women’s Networking Group (Eventbrite)
events.editor_note: Ticket price not stated in the accessible event details; omit price unless confirmed.

events.title: Amigos International Festival
events.venue: Ogden Park, 615 Ogden Park Drive, Wilmington, NC 28411
events.description: The 26th annual multicultural festival, formerly known as Festival Latino, featuring international food, live music, dance, a children’s activity area and community-service booths. Free admission. Hours: Saturday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sunday noon–6 p.m.
events.editor_note: Tourism calendar uses the older name 'International Festival' and displays a midnight start; WECT confirms the Amigos International Festival name and daily hours.

events.title: Cucalorus Film Festival
events.venue: Festival hub: Coastline Center at Aloft, 501 Nutt Street, Wilmington, NC 28401; additional screenings and events at Jengo’s Playhouse, Thalian Hall, CFCC Wilson Center, Hi-Wire Brewing, The Rift and The Pointe 14.
events.description: The 32nd annual Cucalorus Film Festival, with film screenings, performances, conversations and social events. Ticket/pass prices listed by the Arts Council range from $15 to $300.
events.editor_note: Recommend one festival-level listing only; do not add individual film sessions until the official schedule is checked for cancellations/changes.

events.title: Third Annual Cape Fear Book Festival
events.venue: Friday kickoff: New Hanover County Arboretum, 6206 Oleander Drive, Wilmington, NC 28403; Nov. 21–22 activities: New Hanover County Main Library, 230 Grace Street, Suite A, Wilmington, NC 28401
events.description: A free public festival organized by the New Hanover County Public Library and Friends of the Library. Friday’s kickoff features author Georgann Eubanks at 2:30 p.m.; Saturday includes writing workshops; Sunday’s free Cover-to-Cover Book Sale runs 1–4 p.m.
events.editor_note: Festival continues through Nov. 22; workshop registration is required for some Saturday sessions, while the Friday kickoff and Sunday book sale are free.
